_readme: Website-only details for publications, keyed by the CV publication id (cv/data/publications.yaml). title: sentence-case title shown on the site; selected: show on the home page; tags: research-page blocks (home1-3, strand1-5); takeaway: one plain-language sentence; links: extra buttons (Preprint, Code, Software, Slides, Policy brief); hide: leave off the site.
